items.title: Bley Carla — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I sat at a table with my friend and her brother, and we were totally... we just listened and we didn't talk or anything... But later on of course I came to like those two guys very much, Gerry Mulligan, he was a great writer.

ctx.x: Yeah, one of his iconic pieces there that...

That’s it. “Flying Home,” wow. Then, a friend of mine had older brothers, one of them was into jazz, took me and my friend to the Blackhawk to see Gerry Mulligan and Chet Baker. That was really, I didn’t understand a thing they were doing but thought this is very... this is very important.
